component.name: Theme Hub
component.summary: Handcrafted desktop themes and look-and-feel switcher for Linux

description.p: Theme Hub is a unified appearance switcher for Linux supporting GNOME and KDE Plasma. It enables instant switching between handcrafted desktop themes with a single click:

ul.li: Modern Aesthetic: Dark minimalist look with Inter fonts, Tela Circle icons, and floating dock.
macOS Sonoma: Apple top menu bar with Global AppMenu, floating glass dock, WhiteSur icons, and Sonoma 4K wallpaper.
Original Stock: Clean, safe, one-click restoration of default system settings.
